models_evaluated: Vendor A FDA-cleared dental AI decision support
Vendor B FDA-cleared dental AI decision support

links.outcome: Local retrospective validation of AI caries and bone loss detection against longitudinal ground truth
links.effect: Caries: vendor A 78.68% concordance, 80.17% specificity, 96.92% NPV; vendor B 82.43%, 83.76%, 97.36%. Bone loss: vendor A 78.47%, 94.23%, 80.64%; vendor B 73.89%, 93.55%, 75.20%.
links.quote: For caries detection, vendor A achieved 78.68% concordance, 80.17% specificity, and 96.92% NPV; vendor B achieved 82.43%, 83.76%, and 97.36%, respectively.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation study assessing diagnostic performance (specificity, NPV, concordance) of two FDA-cleared dental AI decision support tools without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
